facts.label: Distinctive architecture
facts.value: superflybridge with upper deck and main deck running almost the full length
facts.note: Official X Class announcement describes the expansive flybridge and main deck extending nearly the yacht's full length.

layout.description: The original X95 is a three-level architectural concept: a full-length upper deck with walkaround terrace and enclosed sky lounge/pilothouse, a main deck dominated by a flexible saloon and optional owner/forward lounge-country-kitchen arrangement, and a lower deck with a standard four-cabin guest layout. The main-deck master can create a five-cabin/ten-guest configuration; optional crew/cinema/jacuzzi layouts are not part of the reference configuration.

visual.hullDescription: Tall, planing GRP hull with a short wave-piercing bow, broad aft running surfaces and an unusually high volume/length relationship.
visual.superstructureDescription: Signature Super Flybridge architecture: a raised enclosed pilothouse/sky lounge between long fore and aft upper-deck terraces, with deep side overhangs and an elevated profile.
visual.glazingDescription: Extensive full-height glazing and long side glass create a floating-window effect; the original brochure shows large saloon glazing, sky-lounge windows and a forward-facing main-deck/master option.
distinctiveFeatures: Super Flybridge / near full-length upper deck
optional main-deck master with private foredeck
Transformer hydraulic platform and PWC garage

uncertainties: Original X95 dimensions are consistent between the official brochure and Power & Motoryacht, while YachtBuyer’s later model database reports a shorter/narrower 28.96/6.65/2.03 m set; the canonical profile follows the original official brochure and records the independent database conflict.
The original X95 was highly configurable: standard four-cabin and optional five-cabin/main-deck-master layouts are both documented, so no single interior configuration represents every hull.
The 2020–2023 production window is from independent model tracking; the official sources establish launch in 2020 and successor X95 Vista in 2024 but do not publish a factory end date.
